paper: XALPHA: A Memory-Driven AI Quant Researcher for Hypothesis-to-Code Alpha Discovery
headline_agent: report-grounded memory routing, hypothesis-to-code factor evolution, selected factor library, Ridge fusion, and Qlib Top-50/drop-5 strategy
component_selection_reason: The complete factor library and fused model are withheld, but the main text singles out one representative elite factor, prints its complete executable code, reports positive signed train/test IC, and the paper audit verifies its output-name contract and prefix causality. This is the strongest source-selected executable partial before new JKP inspection.
source_direction: positive; the paper reports signed test IC = 0.0440 for this factor
source_mechanism: Detect downside price overshoot relative to a 20-bar moving average, weight it by absolute return, accumulate pressure, choose fast or slow EWMA decay by a rolling volatility regime, and subtract the expanding 75th-percentile pressure benchmark.

monthly_adapter.bar_mapping: One source day becomes one JKP month; the 20/60-bar windows and 5/15-span EWMA retain their integer values as months.
monthly_adapter.input: Absolute JKP formation-month prc supplies close; source rolling, sample-volatility, EWMA, threshold, and expanding-quantile semantics are preserved.
monthly_adapter.universe: Fixed formation-date largest 1,000 U.S. equities from the common JKP contract.
monthly_adapter.portfolio: Researcher-supplied common value-weighted long/short deciles from the literal positive factor score.
monthly_adapter.costs: Common 0/5/10/25/50 bp one-way cases with 10 bp primary.
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: Fixed holdings re-accounted under zero and adverse-100 policies without reranking or reweighting.
monthly_adapter.history: A 120-month pre-formation close buffer supports all nested windows; no future price or return enters a score.
